basic_info.description: Prime West Clay Park! Extraordinary Golden Gate Bridge views! Located in one of the cities most desirable and prestigious neighborhoods, on a premium block this grand,state-of-the art 3 story, detached home has been renovated by the current owner using high-end luxury finishes and design. It is spectacular! Situated perfectly on a lg lot it showcases & frames the awe inspiring Bridge & Marin headlands views from multiple rooms, views on all floors including garden! The floor plan includes a central view foyer with skylight & grand staircase, view living room w/ fireplace, formal dining rm w/ custom bay windows & remodeled open eat-in kitchen. 4 lg bdrms 2 baths on the top floor includes a breathtaking view Primary en-suite. The lower level includes a media rm that opens out to the view garden, guest bdrm, hm office, bathrm, laundry rm, & an abundance of custom built-ins. Gorgeous curb appeal, exquisite renovations, stunning architectural detail, panoramic views, coveted location, beautifully landscaped walkout backyard are the hallmarks of this extraordinary home. Close to great schools, parks, shops, restaurants and walking trails. Lg Garage & an additional parking pad offers space for two large cars and is easily accessed from the back of the home.
